create_block_pool: create a BlockPool instance to manage KV cache blocks with configurable prefix caching and event tracking
get_cached_block: get cached KV cache blocks by block hash and KV cache group IDs for prefix caching lookup
cache_full_blocks: cache full KV cache blocks for a request to enable prefix caching with block hash metadata
get_new_blocks: allocate new free KV cache blocks from the pool with reference counting and optional eviction
reset_prefix_cache: reset the entire prefix cache by clearing all block hashes and freeing cached entries
